title: 第19章 巨石传送阵第20章 圣墟由来
content_zh:
休息了好一阵子之后，沐云总算是恢复了气力，他看了一下方位，便往着东北的方向前行。
沐云现在所处的这个地方，其实已经不在大汉帝国的境内。若严格说起来，应该用洞天福地，亦或者微型位面来定义。像这样子的地方，整个“帝望”里面，有着整整108处，而这也是沐云此行的目的之一。
沐云走了许久，终于在天黑之前，看到了一处用巨石堆砌的建筑，或者该用祭坛来形容会更恰当。
无数或长或方，或厚或薄的石头，在中间堆砌起了一个直径达十米，高度达两米的平台。平台的东西南北四面，各有着九层的石阶，而平台外围，耸立着八根高达八米，宽三米，厚三米的石柱。这八根石柱的上面，在东南西北四方，还横摆着一块长条状的巨石，正好与直立的石柱形成平台四面石阶的“门”。
沐云通过了位处南边，由巨石形成的“门”，他踏上了九层石阶，来到了平台中央。
系统：“您发现了古代遗迹，察觉到遗迹上似乎残留着某种痕迹。”
沐云看着平台，似乎有着某种怀念，以及难言的钦佩......
沐云掏出了一大把的金币，将之撒在了平台之上。说也奇怪，这些金币一掉到平台上，就像被黏住了一般动都不会动。
只是若仔细的看，会发现这些金币慢慢的融化着，不！更像是被平台“吞噬”着。
沐云一把又一把的将金币撒在平台上，等他撒够了整整一万枚金币时，系统终于又传来了提示的讯息。
系统：“您发现了遗迹在吞噬着金币，某种能量正在被激活着。”
沐云站在平台上，等待着平台上的金币彻底的被平台“吞噬”掉。
当平台的金币彻底消失的同时，系统传来了讯息。
系统：“恭喜玩家沐云，激活了古代遗迹-巨石传送阵，您获得了1点传奇点数，您获得了点经验。”
系统：“由于您的资质超群，额外获得了八倍的经验，恭喜玩家沐云，获得了点经验。”
系统：“恭喜玩家沐云，您的等级获得了提升，现在等级为：21级，您获得了600点素质点”。
系统：“恭喜玩家沐云，您取得了古代遗迹-巨石传送阵的使用权。”
尽管沐云只是本尊的精血转世分身，但是本源是一样的，因此拥有着Ｚ级资质，而Ｚ级资质的附加属性是“全经验，额外获得800％”。
Ａ级资质，是层次最低的资质，每升一级可以获得5点素质点。
然而，资质每提升一级，每次升级便能额外获得1点素质。也就是说，B级资质每次升级获得6点素质点，C级资质每次升级获得7点素质点。而沐云是Ｚ级资质，每升一级便获得整整30点的素质点，20级X30，刚好是600点。

这也是为什么，无论是轩辕亢明也好，亦或者艾洛西亚也好，身为“重生者”，却在得知自身的资质为Ｃ级时，还会如此高兴的重要原因。
在“帝望”中，资质的提升是相当困难的，无论是对于玩家来说，亦或者对于原住民NPC来说都一样，而这也造就了高资质存在的珍稀度。
沐云眼前的这个“古代遗迹-巨石传送阵”，可以与整个大汉帝国的传送阵做连接，进行传送但是若只是为了这个传送阵，根本不值得沐云费了这么多功夫来到这边。
沐云拿出了一枚毫金币，扬手清清一抛，就落在了古代遗迹-巨石传送阵的平台上面。
顿时，古代遗迹-巨石传送阵的平台发生了剧烈的震动，那一枚毫金币用肉眼可见的速度被平台给“吞噬”了！
系统：“您的毫金币，似乎对古代遗迹-巨石传送阵产生了某种影响。”
沐云笑了笑，不就是砸钱吗？这个我在行！很快的，一把又一把的毫金币，被沐云挥撒而出，落在了平台上面。
随着毫金币的数量撒越多，终于古代遗迹-！巨石传送阵停止了震动，一道光柱从天而降，垄罩着整个平台接着就像在放窜天猴一般，整整107道流光从平台向着天空，向着四面八方射去。这时，沐云撒落在平台上的毫金币，刚好整整一万多一点。
系统：“恭喜玩家沐云，激活了古代遗迹-巨石传送阵的串连通道，您获得了1点史诗点数，您获得了10万点经验”。
系统：“由于您的资质超群，额外获得了八倍的经验，恭喜玩家沐云，获得了80万点经验。”
系统：“恭喜玩家沐云，激活了107座古代遗迹-巨石传送阵，您获得了107点传奇点数，您获得了107万点经验”。
content_en:
After resting for a while, Mu Yun finally regained his strength. He looked at the direction and headed northeast.
The place where Mu Yun is now is actually no longer within the territory of the Han Empire. Strictly speaking, it should be defined as the Cave Heaven Paradise, or the Micro Plane. There are 108 places like this in the entire "Diwang", and this is also one of the purposes of Mu Yun's trip.
Mu Yun walked for a long time, and finally before dark, he saw a building made of huge rocks, or it would be more appropriate to describe it as an altar.
Countless long or square, thick or thin stones were piled up in the middle to build a platform with a diameter of ten meters and a height of two meters. There are nine stone steps on the east, west, north and south sides of the platform, and eight stone pillars eight meters high, three meters wide and three meters thick stand on the outside of the platform. On top of these eight stone pillars, there is also a long strip of huge stone placed horizontally in the southeast, northwest and four directions, which happens to form the "door" of the stone steps on the four sides of the platform with the upright stone pillars.
Mu Yun passed the "door" formed by huge rocks in the south. He stepped on the nine stone steps and arrived at the center of the platform.
System: "You have discovered ancient ruins and noticed that there seems to be some trace left on the ruins."
Mu Yun looked at the platform, seeming to have some kind of nostalgia and unspeakable admiration...
Mu Yun took out a large handful of gold coins and scattered them on the platform. Strangely enough, once these gold coins fell onto the platform, they seemed to be stuck and would not move.
But if you look carefully, you will find that these gold coins are slowly melting, no! It’s more like being “swallowed” by the platform.
Mu Yun scattered the gold coins on the platform one after another. When he had scattered ten thousand gold coins, the system finally sent another prompt message.
System: "You have discovered that the ruins are devouring gold coins, and some kind of energy is being activated."
Mu Yun stood on the platform, waiting for the gold coins on the platform to be completely "swallowed" by the platform.
When the gold coins on the platform disappeared completely, a message came from the system.
System: "Congratulations to player Mu Yun, for activating the ancient ruins - the megalithic teleportation array. You have gained 1 legendary point, and you have gained some experience."
System: "Due to your superior qualifications, you have gained eight times more experience. Congratulations to player Mu Yun for gaining some experience."
System: "Congratulations to player Mu Yun, your level has been improved. Now it is level 21. You have obtained 600 quality points."
System: "Congratulations to player Mu Yun, you have obtained the right to use the ancient ruins - the giant stone teleportation array."
Although Mu Yun is just the reincarnation of the original deity, his origin is the same, so he has Z-level qualifications, and the additional attributes of Z-level qualifications are "full experience, additional 800% gain".
A-level qualification is the lowest level qualification. You can get 5 quality points for each level.
However, for each level of qualification, you can gain 1 additional quality point for each upgrade. In other words, B-level qualifications will gain 6 quality points for each upgrade, and C-level qualifications will gain 7 quality points for each upgrade. As for Mu Yun, who has Z-level qualifications, he will get a full 30 quality points every time he levels up. Level 20 x 30 is exactly 600 points.
This is also an important reason why whether it is Xuanyuan Kangming or Aelosia, as a "reborn person", they are so happy when they learn that their qualifications are C level.
In "Emperor's Hope", it is quite difficult to improve qualifications, both for players and aboriginal NPCs, and this also creates the rarity of high qualifications.
The "ancient ruins-boulder teleportation array" in front of Mu Yun can be connected to the teleportation arrays in the entire Han Empire for teleportation. But if it is just for this teleportation array, it is not worth Mu Yun's effort to come here.
Mu Yun took out a piece of goldHe raised his hand and tossed the coin, and it landed on the platform of the ancient ruins - the giant stone teleportation array.
Suddenly, the platform of the ancient ruins - the giant stone teleportation array shook violently, and the gold coin was "swallowed" by the platform at a speed visible to the naked eye!
System: "Your gold coins seem to have had some influence on the ancient ruins - the megalithic teleportation array."
Mu Yun smiled, isn't it just throwing money? I'm good at this! Soon, handfuls of gold coins were thrown out by Mu Yun and landed on the platform.
As the number of gold coins increased, finally the ancient ruins -! The boulder teleportation array stopped vibrating, and a beam of light fell from the sky, covering the entire platform. Then, like a flying monkey, a total of 107 streams of light shot from the platform to the sky and in all directions. At this time, the number of gold coins that Mu Yun scattered on the platform was just over 10,000.
System: "Congratulations to player Mu Yun, for activating the connecting channel of the ancient ruins - the megalithic teleportation array. You have obtained 1 epic point, and you have gained 100,000 experience points."
System: "Due to your superior qualifications, you have gained eight times more experience. Congratulations to player Mu Yun for gaining 800,000 experience points."
System: "Congratulations to player Mu Yun, for activating 107 ancient ruins - the megalithic teleportation array. You have gained 107 legendary points, and you have gained 1.07 million experience points."
